description: List API operations for a service resource with covering-test previews, coverageSummary scores, observability mapping state, and runtimeObservation from the latest finalized production daily summary (with latest-hour fallback). runtimeObservation may include window bounds, requestCount/rpm, errorCount/errorRate, p50/p95/p99LatencyMs, status-class counts, and syncStatus. Missing observability is unknown/not configured, not zero. Use these signals to prioritize uncovered high-volume/high-error operations; prefer --root-file-path.
name: list-api-operations
